about.title: Charge Point Admin
about.subtitle: Platform for managing and monitoring OCPP EV charge points
about.description: CPAdmin lets you monitor, control, and manage your OCPP 1.6 and OCPP 2.0.1 compatible charge points from a centralized interface.
about.feature1: Real-time dashboard for charge points and connectors
about.accessNotice: Access to this application is reserved for users previously authorized by an administrator. New accounts cannot be created freely.
about.googleDataNotice: When signing in with Google, the application only uses your email address and profile name for authentication purposes. No Gmail, Google Drive, Google Calendar, or other sensitive Google data is accessed or stored by the application.
